title: Permission Pre-Ask
summary: Explains why a permission is needed before the browser's one-shot prompt, and shows this browser's re-enable steps if it is blocked.
description: In-page pre-ask for browser permissions that explains why before calling the real API, tells a closed prompt from a block, shows this browser's exact re-enable steps, and flips to on by itself once the user allows it.
catches: Spending the browser prompt before the user knows why
Browser-specific steps to turn a blocked permission back on (iOS uses Settings)
Permission granted later from settings: detected
limits: The Permissions API doesn't report every permission in every browser
Re-enable steps are written for major browsers and can drift as they change
Can't re-show the browser prompt once blocked
a11y: Container uses role=status; the blocked panel is a labelled region
Allow and Not now are buttons
stops: Wasted the browser's one permission prompt
